assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: synthetic tutorial Original image for the SynapseGit README and creator pilot. Edit the supplied synthetic coastal mural image as the target, refreshing it with polished, natural, detailed image quality while preserving its design and visual identity. Keep the same frontal camera view, the entire rectangular mural on a pale plaster wall, a narrow visible floor strip, three angular seabirds, cream clouds, muted blue-green sea with thin horizontal wave lines, faceted ochre and brown cliffs with the small dark cave, dark green headland and foreground agave forms. Preserve the same composition, positions, colors, scale and 4:3 landscape framing. This is the earlier Original condition: gentle age and plaster patina, no obvious long structural crack and no conspicuous missing-paint patch. Make textures physically plausible, subtle and clearly readable at README thumbnail size. It must remain a fictional, AI-generated tutorial mural, not a real heritage object or a documented conservation treatment. No people, signage, text, logo or watermark; no glossy digital gradients, no new decorative objects. Output a single high-quality PNG image, approximately 1440 by 1080 pixels.

The supplied image is the freshly generated Original baseline. Change only its conservation condition, keeping the same 1448x1086 4:3 canvas, exact frontal view, rectangular mural boundaries, floor and wall, geometric coast, three seabirds, clouds, colors, cave and agave composition. Add two conspicuous but plausible condition problems: one narrow dark hairline structural crack running irregularly downward from the top edge near the center-left, through the cream cloud and down toward the blue sea; and one small ragged off-white missing-pigment/plaster patch on the lower part of the front ochre cliff near the cave, with a few small flakes at its edge. The rest of the mural, composition and texture must stay essentially identical to the reference. These visible defects should be easy to notice in a three-image comparison at README scale, while avoiding exaggerated destruction or grime. Keep this a fictional AI-generated tutorial image, no real-world treatment claims. No text, logos, people or watermark. Output one PNG at the same dimensions and framing as the reference.
